text:
nora_csm: Sharing a tiny 'ColdStart Guardian' rescue runbook we used yesterday with a POC that hit cold-start churn. Focus = fast mitigation + renewal-safe comms. Short and copyable for customer calls. :shield:

felix_eng: Nice name. Can you paste the 6-step live checklist we actually read on the preflight? I want this on the customer-facing one-pager.

amanda_onboard: Hereit is (2-3 min):
1) Confirm warmpool_target = 10 for first 3 hours.
2) Prefill prefix_cache with top 30 prefixes from sample logs.
3) Seed KV/prefix long-tail for top 8 active users.
4) Set stream_fallback_ms = 700 (p50 first-token).
5) Ensure client sends X-Client-Queue, X-Session-Hint, X-Idempotency-Key.
6) Wire feedback webhook to ping at 24h and 72h.

remy_sre: Ops clarifier: we evaluate stream_fallback on p50 first-token. Flip to non-stream for a tenant after 4 misses in 12m. If warm_pool_miss_rate > 6% over 15m -> page oncall.

felix_eng: Minimal client header snippet for customers to copy:
```
POST /v1/chat/stream
Headers:
  X-Client-Queue: tenant-<TENANT_ID>-<hex>
  X-Session-Hint: app-<session_id>
  X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
  Accept: text/event-stream
```

nora_csm: Renewal-risk quick rule we used in the rescue: usage drop >= 30% + p95 latency increase >= 180ms + negative 24h feedback -> create a "Rescue & Reassure" ticket and schedule a 48h remediation call. If customer agrees, enable short-term reserved capacity and increase warm_pool to 14.

amanda_onboard: Enablement cadence we read out: Kickoff, 6h smoke, 24h perf check, 72h stabilization, 7d adoption + cost review. Log decisions in playbook card.

felix_eng: Tiny emulator we hand to customers for prelaunch (one-liner):
```bash
seq 1 300 | xargs -n1 -P20 -I{} curl -s -H "X-Client-Queue: tenant-$TENANT" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &>/dev/null
wait
```

remy_sre: Monitoring rules to add to tenant card:
- warmpool_miss_rate > 5% over 10m -> create ticket + notify CSM
- first_token_p50 > 800ms for 5+ reqs in 10m -> set tenant->non-streaming
- streaming_partial_rate > 2% over 15m -> auto-create follow-up
- feedback_24h <=3 -> auto-assign AM

nora_csm: Feedback capture payload we used (customer-visible):
```json
{ "question": "How useful was the live response? (1-7)", "meta": { "p95_latency_ms": "${p95}", "tokens": "${tokens_sent}" }, "webhook": "https://hooks.redwood.internal/cs-feedback" }
```
Send at 24h and 72h. Scores <=3 -> auto-create a playbook task and assign to AM for outreach.

amanda_onboard: Quick comms script for AMs during rescue calls: "We're seeing early cold starts; we're temporarily enabling an accelerated warm pool and a non-stream fallback to stabilize experience. We'll follow up with a remediation plan in 48 hours." Keep it short and set expectations.

ops-bot: Playbook created: https://board.redwood.internal/play/55021 tags=[coldstart-guardian, warmpool, rescue, feedback] :white_check_mark:

remy_sre: Pro tip: run the emulator replay while gradually increasing a single client header (X-Session-Hint) variance to surface cache noise. Helps find eviction thresholds before go-live.

nora_csm: I'll paste this into the customer-runbooks repo and add the AM script. Team: please flag any additional quick checks and I'll update the playcard. Thanks! :handshake:
